coverage_limits: TEHTRIS timed out; it supplied no completed verdict. Its recorded 1.8.0 result was Undetected.
Avast-Mobile, BitDefenderFalx, Symantec Mobile Insight and Trustlook cannot process this file type. These four outcomes are not clean scans.
Behavior analysis is still in progress at the captured observation. Interim NOT FOUND fields are not a completed clean result.
The report overview does not expose vendor reasons or engine versions; no vendor-confirmed false-positive decision exists for this exact hash.
The full standalone EXE was the report target, but per-member inspection by every engine is not established.
63 undetected engines do not establish safety. The 7/70 count is not proof of improvement over 8/71 on another binary.
assessment_scope: Bounded source/bundle and exact-report review; not comprehensive malware exclusion.
recommendation: Ready for the owner's explicit residual-risk disposition, with all seven unresolved warnings, timeout, unsupported outcomes and incomplete behavioral coverage disclosed. Do not publish before that decision and root readiness.
